```yaml
name: Release Scrapers

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up OCaml
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v2
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: "ocaml"
          ocaml-compiler-version: "5.2.0"

      - name: Build scraper binary
        run: dune build @scrape.exe

      - name: Upload scraper binary to release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: _build/default/bin/scrape.exe
          tag: scraper-latest
          asset_name: scrape.exe
          overwrite: true
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          make_latest: true
```
